title: IES Glut 6 Corn (IES Glutinous 6): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: IES Glut 6 Corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: IES Glut 6 corn is a glutinous open pollinated corn variety. About 98 days to harvest, 5.3 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: IES Glut 6 corn is a glutinous open pollinated corn variety, also sold or known as IES Glutinous 6. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2005 as NSIC 2005 Cn 168. CVIARC, Ilagan, Isabela bred it. It takes about 98 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 5.31 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

items: **Days to harvest:** about 98 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain.
**Yield:** 5.31 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.
**Recommended for:** anywhere in the country, in the dry season.

blocks.text: Key facts about IES Glut 6 corn
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

IES Glut 6 corn takes about 98 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is about the average of the 19 glutinous open pollinated corn varieties with a day count, 97.1 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 5.31 t/ha beats the average of its group, 5.09. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives about 98.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It was weak against corn borer, corn earworm, so scout for them from the early weeks. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [Corn rust](/diseases/corn-rust), [Corn stalk rot](/diseases/corn-stalk-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn planthopper](/pests/corn-planthopper). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Against lodging it rated resistant, so it stood up well when wind and rain pushed the plants.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: Moderately resistant to corn borer and earworm.
Registry rates it resistant to lodging, rust and stalk rot.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: on the recommended corn list, seed sold at CVIARC in Ilagan. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant IES Glut 6 corn

It is recommended for anywhere in the country in the dry season. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Is IES Glutinous 6 the same as IES Glut 6?
items.a: Yes. IES Glutinous 6 is another name for IES Glut 6, registered as NSIC 2005 Cn 168. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 98 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 5.31 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
Yes. It is open pollinated, so seed from a clean, isolated field grows true. Still, certified seed gives the best start every few seasons.
It is recommended for anywhere in the country in the dry season. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of IES Glut 6?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
